[!TIP] Start with our Complete Rooting Guide before exploring apps below. For privacy-friendly installs, use the F-Droid ecosystem: install Droid-ify (modern F-Droid client) and enable the IzzyOnDroid repo for many additional packages.
[!NOTE] Clicking an app/module entry opens its Source Code page (GitHub/GitLab etc.) for apps, otherwise the Google Play Store listing.

children.description: A minimalist, high-stealth implementation using ptrace injection. It focuses on "trace cleaning," aiming to remove all injection artifacts from memory once modules are loaded.
A feature that lets modules inject code into Android's Zygote process for system-level modifications like root hiding and app patching.
